title: Import handoff manifest
description: handoff.json, the share extension's commit record in the App Group inbox (plan 6.1, 8.1; ADR-0010). The extension streams every item into <inbox>/<handoff_id>/items/, syncs it, and writes this file last, atomically (temporary file, F_FULLFSYNC, rename without replace, directory sync). It reports receipt only after that. A handoff directory without this file is incomplete by definition and is never imported. Rules the schema cannot express and readers must enforce: handoff_id equals the name of the directory holding the file; stored_path values and item_id values are unique; total_bytes is the sum of byte_count; the items directory holds exactly the listed files, each a regular file whose size and SHA-256 match. original_filename is metadata only and is never used as a path. The file is private to the app and its extension, never leaves the device, and holds no credential.

handoff_id.description: UUID generated by the extension; also the handoff directory's name.

total_bytes.description: Sum of every item's byte_count, in bytes.

stored_path.description: Relative to the handoff directory: items/<ordinal> with an optional lowercase alphanumeric extension. Generated by the extension, never derived from the shared file name beyond its sanitized extension.

original_filename.description: The shared file's name, for display only. At most 255 UTF-8 bytes (readers check bytes; maxLength here counts characters).

content_type.description: Uniform type identifier of the supported type the item was received as (EPUB, PDF, plain text, Markdown or audio).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes, computed while streaming the copy.

representation.description: file_representation: an NSItemProvider file representation of a supported type. file_url: a public.file-url item the extension could read.

provider_type_identifier.description: The type identifier the item was loaded with.
